decisions.reason: After four years with only weak visibility and no later website evidence, this peripheral consumable no longer offers enough unresolved upside to justify keeping the option open.

Custom earmolds remain tightly aligned with the firm's hearing-care channels and bespoke manufacturing base, so despite limited public visibility they are still worth retaining as a coherent niche line.

Hearing-protection earmolds use similar capabilities but serve a narrower segment, and with no clear sign of momentum over several years the option value now looks lower than the value of redeploying resources.
